## 1) Purpose

This policy explains what personal data JVTO collects, why it is collected, how it is used, and when it may be shared to operate your tour booking and comply with applicable requirements.

---

## 2) What Data We Collect

JVTO may collect the following categories of data, depending on your booking and itinerary requirements:

**2.1 Contact and booking details (lead guest):**

- Full name
- Email address
- WhatsApp/mobile number
- Booking references and tour details needed to deliver services

**2.2 Participant details (where required):**

- Guest list for accommodation and permits
- Passport/ID details and date of birth where required for permits, tickets, or legal compliance
- Pickup/drop-off details, rooming preferences, and operational notes required to deliver services

**2.3 Safety and logistics information (where relevant):**

- Dietary needs and relevant health information provided by you for safety planning and operational coordination (only where necessary)

---

## 3) Why We Collect and Use Your Data

JVTO uses personal data to:

- Issue and deliver your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF) and manage your booking
- Coordinate logistics before and during your tour (pickup timing, accommodation, vehicles, guides, route planning)
- Provide customer support and operational assistance
- Meet legal, permit, ticketing, and accommodation registration requirements where applicable
- Support safety processes and emergency response coordination where needed

---

## 4) When We Share Your Data

JVTO shares personal data only when required to deliver the booked services or comply with applicable requirements. This may include sharing necessary details with:

- Accommodation partners (for check-in/registration and rooming)
- Drivers, escort guides, local site guides, and operational teams (for coordination and guest support)
- Ticketing/permit partners and local authorities where permits or entry requirements apply
- Medical screening providers or approved facilities where screening applies or where required by authorities for specific sites

JVTO does not share data beyond what is necessary for the specific operational purpose.

---

## 5) Payment Data

- Card payments are processed through a secure checkout and authorised payment gateway.
- JVTO does not store full card numbers, CVV codes, or online banking passwords.

---

## 6) Data Protection and Access

JVTO applies internal controls to protect personal data and limits access to authorised personnel and partners only when needed for service delivery.

---

## 7) Contact

For privacy or data-related requests, contact:

- Email: `hello@javavolcano-touroperator.com`
- WhatsApp: `+62 822-4478-8833`

content.body_md:
## 1) Purpose

This policy defines what is included and not included in JVTO private tour packages. Only inclusions written on your specific **Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF)** are contractually binding.

---

## 2) Contractual Rule (Write-it-to-Bind-it)

In this policy, “Official Tour Voucher” refers to your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF) issued by JVTO after successful payment.

Only inclusions that appear on:

- the official JVTO package page for your chosen tour; and/or
- your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF)

are legally binding components of your package.

If it is not written in your confirmed inclusions and voucher, it is not part of the contracted package, even if discussed informally.

---

## 3) Standard Inclusions (All Eligible JVTO Packages)

Unless stated otherwise on your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF), a confirmed JVTO private tour package typically includes:

### 3.1 Transportation

- Private air-conditioned vehicle for all land sectors listed in your confirmed itinerary
- Fuel, tolls, and standard parking fees as per itinerary
- Vehicle allocation by group size (comfort and safety):

  - 2–3 guests: 1 × MPV (e.g., Toyota Avanza or similar)
  - 4–9 guests: 1 × Toyota Hiace (or similar 16-seat minibus)
  - 10–11 guests: 1 × Toyota Hiace + 1 × MPV (for seating and luggage space)

- 4WD Jeep at Mount Bromo (when Bromo is included):

  - Private jeep(s) for sunrise and crater viewpoints
  - Max. ±4 guests per jeep for comfort and safety

### 3.2 Accommodation

- Hotel / homestay accommodation for all overnight stays listed in your itinerary
- Standard allocation (unless otherwise stated on your voucher):

  - Even-numbered groups: 1 room per 2 guests (King or Twin)
  - Odd-numbered groups: 1 room per 2 guests + 1 extra bed in one room

- Rooming principles:

  - Maximum 2 guests per standard room (excluding the designated extra bed where applicable)
  - King beds for couples or guests preferring more space
  - Twin beds for guests sharing a room

- Upgrade option (subject to request and availability): replacing an extra bed with an additional private room may be available at a published supplement (as per voucher)

### 3.3 Professional Crew

- Licensed, vetted crew adjusted by group size and route:

  - 2–3 guests: 1 × driver-guide (English-speaking) + licensed local site guides where required
  - 4–11 guests: 1 × professional driver + 1 × escort guide + licensed local site guides at key locations
  - Additional drivers allocated when extra vehicles are used

- Crew duties include: safe driving, time management, coordination with hotels/jeeps/ferries/park authorities, and basic route explanations and guest support

### 3.4 Tickets, Permits & Local Logistics

All listed entrance tickets and environmental/park permits connected to your confirmed itinerary, where applicable, such as:

- Mount Bromo National Park access
- Mount Ijen (including regular entrance and applicable summit/crater access where legally permitted)
- Madakaripura Waterfall
- Tumpak Sewu Waterfall
- Other named attractions in your confirmed program
- Local retribution / standard local fees where explicitly built into the package

### 3.5 Mount Ijen Safety & Trekking Support (When Ijen is Included)

- Professional gas mask (rated for sulfur environment) for each participating guest
- Trekking poles (shared or individual, depending on configuration)
- Ijen medical check & digital/printed clearance arranged by JVTO when required under current access rules or permit conditions, conducted by licensed medical personnel at an approved facility or at your hotel in the Bondowoso area (included in the package for itineraries that visit Ijen)

### 3.6 Meals & Water

- Daily bottled mineral water in the vehicle for overland sectors
- Hotel breakfasts for each included overnight stay
- Any additional included meals (e.g., set dinners or lunches) are included only when explicitly stated on the official package page and/or your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF)

### 3.7 Java-Bali Ferry (Where Applicable)

Ferry tickets for Java-Bali or Bali-Java sectors when:

- the crossing is listed in your itinerary; and
- the ticket is specified as included on your voucher

### 3.8 JVTO Branded Inclusions & Group Extras

- 1 × JVTO travel T-shirt per participant for eligible packages (standard JVTO design; size selection via “Complete Your Details”)
- Custom JVTO Group T-shirt (where explicitly included): for groups of ≥12 guests in a single booking, if written on your package/voucher; 1 × custom design T-shirt per person; sizes and final design must be confirmed before production

### 3.9 On-Trip Support & Coordination

- Pre-trip assistance via official WhatsApp/email
- Clear pickup instructions and emergency contact numbers on your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF)
- On-trip coordination for timing, weather/closure adjustments, and safety decisions
- Support in case of incident (basic first response, coordination with local clinics/hospitals, and logistics adjustments where feasible)

---

## 4) “We Offer More” — Conditional Inclusions (Only If Written)

The following are included **only** when clearly stated on both:

- the official package description you booked; and
- your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF)

Conditional inclusions may include:

- Custom JVTO group T-shirts (design, quantity, eligibility conditions)
- Additional hosted meals (e.g., dinner in Bondowoso before Ijen; lunch after Tumpak Sewu; special farewell dinner)
- Bali hotel/airport transfers beyond the standard ferry crossing
- Early check-in / late check-out at hotels
- Dedicated photographer/videographer services
- Police escort or special convoy arrangements for VIP/large groups (subject to availability and regulation)

**Extra meals — specific itinerary conditions (only if written):**

- For Ijen + Bondowoso overnight itineraries:

  - Dinner at the Bondowoso hotel before the Ijen night trek
  - Lunch at the Bondowoso hotel after returning from Ijen

- For itineraries including Tumpak Sewu:

  - One additional lunch at/near Yanto Homestay (or equivalent local partner) after the Tumpak Sewu program

---

## 5) Exclusions (Simple Principle)

To keep things clear: anything that is not explicitly listed as an inclusion on the official package page and on your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF) is excluded.

Common examples of not included items (unless clearly written as included for your specific booking):

- International / domestic flights and entry visas
- Travel insurance of any kind
- Meals not specified (including alcohol)
- Tips/gratuities for guides and drivers
- Madakaripura helmets (provided by local site management at the canyon entrance — not a JVTO inclusion)

---

## 6) Discrepancies

This policy is designed to integrate with your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF). In the event of any discrepancy, the version referenced on your booking confirmation and voucher will apply.

---

content.body_md:
## How booking works

**Website-only booking.** JVTO accepts bookings exclusively through the official website checkout under a valid JVTO Booking ID. WhatsApp/email are support channels only — they never create, confirm, modify, cancel, or transfer a booking.

---

## Deposit & payment

- **Standard deposit**: 20% of total booking value (card via secure JVTO link)
- **Close-departure rule**: if Day 1 is within 14 days, JVTO may require up to 100% full payment
- **Card balance deadline**: no later than 5 days before Day 1
- **Bank wire / Wise balance deadline**: no later than 3 days before Day 1
- **Cash at JVTO office**: only if approved in writing in advance

---

## Lifetime Package Guarantee — the rules in plain language

**Lifetime Package Guarantee**

Your confirmed package does not disappear when plans change early. Cancel your entire booking at least 48 hours before Day 1 and the same package, your original number of travellers, and your original confirmed package price remain available for future use as Lifetime Package Credit.

**Cancel your booking 48h+ before Day 1**

Cancel the complete booking 48 hours or more before Day 1: you receive Lifetime Package Credit. It never expires and preserves the same package, original pax entitlement, and original confirmed price, and can be transferred once. Package Credit is not cash and cannot be exchanged for cash.

**Cancel within 48h of Day 1**

Cancel the complete booking less than 48 hours before Day 1: the booking is forfeited and no Package Credit is created.

**One traveller cancels (booking continues)**

If one or more travellers cancel but the tour continues, the cancelled travellers receive a cash refund of their confirmed price: 100% at 48 hours or more before Day 1, 50% within 48 hours, and 0% after Day 1. At least 2 paying travellers must remain, otherwise it is treated as a full cancellation.

**Flight disruption**

If a verified natural transport disruption (for example volcanic ash) cancels your flight, your package can be reactivated once for a 50% Recovery Fee of the original confirmed package price.

**Destination force majeure**

If a verified official event affects your destination and the whole tour is impossible, you can choose Lifetime Package Credit or a cash refund less any non-recoverable vendor cost. If only part is affected, JVTO first offers an alternative route, then a refund of the affected component.

**Transferring Package Credit**

Package Credit may be transferred once to another person. The old credit code is closed and a new one is issued to the recipient. A second transfer is not permitted.

**Using Package Credit**

To use Package Credit, choose a new date for the same package. Your original pax entitlement appears automatically; fewer travellers yields no refund, and more travellers are charged the incremental website price.

# **Meta**

**Title tag:** Travel Guide – Safety, Health & Practical Information | Java Volcano Tour Operator  
**Meta description:** Official travel guide for private tours with Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO). Learn about booking, safety, Ijen health screening, weather and closures, packing, police escort for groups and ISIC student deals.

## **H1**

**Travel Guide – Safety, Health & Practical Information**

## **Hero Intro**

**Use this Travel Guide as JVTO’s official handbook for planning private tours to Mount Bromo, Kawah Ijen, and Tumpak Sewu.** Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) is presented here as a licensed Indonesian inbound operator based in Bondowoso, specialising in private, all-inclusive routes to East Java’s key volcano and waterfall destinations.

**Understand how JVTO handles safety, health, weather, closures, payments, and student deals before you book or travel.** This page summarises the key topics and directs you to dedicated detail pages for each subject.

**Use your Official E-Voucher / Invoice and the Booking, Payment & Cancellation Policy as the final reference for legal or case-specific details.** This Travel Guide is a plain-language summary designed to help guests understand how things work, but binding terms remain in your official booking documents.

### **Primary CTAs**

**How to book & pay →** /travel-guide/booking-information  
**Browse private tours →** /tours

---

## **Latest JVTO Update (Placeholder Block)**

**Check this “Latest JVTO update” card for time-sensitive operational notes before departure.** This section is reserved for information your team can confirm and update routinely.

**Last updated:** \[DD Month YYYY\]

**Only publish what you can reasonably confirm at the time of update.** Do not include rumours, assumptions, or unverified claims.

---

## **JVTO Operating Status (East Java Volcano Routes)**

**Treat JVTO’s operating status as an operations update for JVTO routes—not a country-level travel advisory.** JVTO currently operates private, pre-booked tours on standard East Java routes, subject to weather, volcanic activity, and access regulations.

**Expect tour plans to follow official sources and local access rules.** We plan and adjust tours based on official information (including MAGMA / PVMBG) and local park management.

**Expect partial restrictions even when tours are running.** Some viewpoints, hiking sections, or waterfall access may be temporarily restricted even when the tour program continues.

**Expect itinerary changes to follow the rules in Weather & Closures and Booking, Payment & Cancellation.** Changes are handled according to those pages and your booking documents.

**Check your own government’s travel advice for country-level alerts.** Guests should consult official travel advisories issued by their own governments in addition to this guide.

---

## **On This Page (In-page Navigation)**

**Use this section as a quick index of the key topics.**

* Safety on JVTO tours  
* Health & Ijen screening

* Packing & fitness

## **Safety on JVTO Tours (Panel Summary)**

**Expect JVTO tours to be run as private-only, pre-briefed programs with defined safety procedures.** JVTO is presented here as a licensed inbound operator led by an active Tourist Police officer in East Java, and all tours are stated to be private-only (no mixed groups, no transport-only tickets).

**Expect routing and decisions to adapt to conditions and regulations.** We monitor official information on volcanic activity and weather, apply safety procedures on roads and trails, and adjust itineraries when conditions or regulations make the original plan unsafe.

**CTA:** Read full safety overview → /travel-guide/safety-on-tours

---

## **Health & Ijen Screening (Panel Summary)**

**Expect Ijen night hikes to require screening and to remain subject to safety decisions even after clearance.** Kawah Ijen is described here as a night hike at altitude with possible sulfur gas exposure.

**Expect screening to be included for eligible JVTO guests and to be digitally verifiable.** For JVTO guests joining Ijen hikes, the package includes a formal health screening by trained medical staff, recorded digitally and verifiable via QR code.

**Expect the public tool to exist, and expect hikes to be modified or cancelled if conditions are unsafe.** The same digital system is described as available to other travellers via a public tool. A cleared screening reduces risk but does not remove it; hikes may still be cancelled or modified based on conditions.

**CTA:** Ijen health screening – what we do and why → /travel-guide/ijen-health-screening

---

## **Weather, Volcano Alerts & Closures (Panel Summary)**

**Expect natural conditions to change access and require adjustments to plans.** Heavy rain, landslides, volcanic ash, gas, smoke, floods, forest fires, road damage, or official ceremonies can affect access to Bromo, Ijen, and Tumpak Sewu.

**Expect JVTO to distinguish partial closures from full closures and propose alternatives where possible.** Some issues affect only one viewpoint or path; others trigger full closure.

**Expect Package Credit options to follow the Booking Policy and your E-Voucher.** When changes are required, JVTO applies the options defined in the Booking, Payment & Cancellation Policy and your Official E-Voucher / Invoice, including Package Credit where applicable.

**CTA:** How JVTO handles weather, volcano alerts and closures → /travel-guide/weather-and-closures

---

## **Packing & Fitness (Panel Summary)**

**Expect these routes to be non-technical but physically demanding for many travellers.** Early starts, night hiking, cold winds, steep paths, stairs, and wet or slippery sections can apply across Bromo, Ijen, and Tumpak Sewu.

**Expect the guide to provide self-checks and packing lists, not medical approval.** The Packing & Fitness guide explains a basic self-check, what to pack for all routes, and extra items for Bromo sunrise, Ijen night hikes, and Tumpak Sewu.

**Expect final hike decisions to follow screening, on-site conditions, and safety assessments.** The guide is a preparation reference; it does not override screening or safety decisions.

**CTA:** Packing list & fitness checklist → /travel-guide/packing-and-fitness

---

## **Booking, Payments & Package Credit (Panel Summary)**

**Expect JVTO bookings to operate as private, all-inclusive tours on a pre-booked basis.** The Booking Information page explains booking requests, confirmation steps, deposits, payment timing, and methods.

**Expect Package Credit to be the core cancellation mechanism rather than cash refunds.** The summary references Package Credit, how it is used, and why cash refunds are not provided, balanced by Package Credit flexibility.

**Expect different time windows to affect cancellations and changes.** The page describes changes, reschedules, and cancellations across different timelines.

**CTA:** Full booking, payment & Package Credit rules → /travel-guide/booking-information

---

## **Traffic Police Escort for Groups (Panel Summary)**

**Expect escort to be considered only for larger groups and only through formal approval.** For larger groups (example: around 18 guests or more with multi-vehicle convoys), JVTO may propose requesting official traffic police escort for specific road segments.

**Expect escort to be official, conditional, documented, and not automatic.** Escort is provided by the official traffic police unit, subject to law, written approval, and availability.

**Expect escort to be for safe convoy movement—not to bypass rules or guarantee faster travel.** If approved, details and any charges are listed in your quotation and Official E-Voucher / Invoice.

**Expect no escort unless it is explicitly written.** If escort is not stated in your booking documents, the tour should be considered to run without escort.

**CTA:** How official traffic police escort works for tourist groups → /travel-guide/police-escort-for-groups

---

## **ISIC Student Deals (Panel Summary)**

**Expect ISIC student deals to be presented as a fairness mechanism against higher foreign fees.** Through collaboration with ISIC, JVTO describes student-focused structures on selected tours for verified students.

**Expect eligibility and verification details to be defined on the ISIC page.** The ISIC page explains eligible tours, how to present valid ISIC identification, and how student pricing interacts with standard booking and Package Credit rules.

**CTA:** ISIC student packages → /isic/student-package

---

## **Official Sources & External Links (Panel Summary)**

**Use official Indonesian sources and your own government’s travel advice alongside this Travel Guide.** JVTO states it monitors official Indonesian authorities for planning and adjustments.

**Use MAGMA Indonesia / PVMBG for volcano and geohazard context, and VONA for advanced aviation-related notices.** Links are presented as references rather than copied content.

**Use local park and government announcements for temporary closures and ceremony-related restrictions.** Access rules may change due to closures, restricted zones, and official events.

**Use your own government’s travel advisory for country-level security, health, and entry requirements.** JVTO positions this guide as complementary to—not a replacement for—government advisories.

---

## **Document Priority Reminder (Bottom of Page)**

**Treat your Official E-Voucher / Invoice as the highest authority for your specific booking.** If there is ever a difference between website wording and booking documents, the order of priority is:

1. Official E-Voucher / Invoice (specific booking)  
2. Booking, Payment & Cancellation Policy  
3. Inclusions & Exclusions Policy  
4. General website text and informal communication

JVTO operates **private, all-inclusive tours** (no shared/open trips, and not a transport-only service).

## 2) How a JVTO Booking Works (Simple Flow)
1. **Choose your tour** on the official website (starting point, duration, route).
2. **Submit your details** at checkout:

   - Verified email address

4. **Receive your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF)** by email.
   - This document is your formal booking confirmation and the final contract for your specific itinerary (dates, pickup, inclusions written on the voucher).

---

## 3) Payments — Deposit, Balance & Methods
### Deposit and short-notice rule
- Standard booking: **20% deposit** of the total package price at checkout.
- Short notice booking: if **Day 1 is less than 14 days** from the time of booking, JVTO may require **up to 100% full payment** at checkout.

### Balance settlement deadlines (if only 20% deposit was paid initially)
- **Credit / Debit card:** balance must be paid no later than **5 calendar days before Day 1**.
- **Bank transfer / Wise:** balance must be received no later than **3 calendar days before Day 1**.
- **Cash (IDR only):** allowed only if explicitly approved in writing; settled at the JVTO office before departure on Day 1.

### Payment security and currency
- Card payments are processed via JVTO’s secure checkout and authorised payment gateway.
- The contracted currency is **IDR** unless otherwise stated in writing for a specific product/promotion.

---

## 4) Changes, Amendments & Rescheduling (Guest-Initiated)
- Any request to amend dates, pickup points, names, or itinerary elements should be made through the official contacts.
- Changes are subject to availability and third-party rules (hotels, parks, jeep providers).
- Any additional costs (if applicable) will be communicated in writing before confirmation.

---

## 5) Cancellations, Package Credit & No-Show (Guest-Initiated)
### Cancellation ≥ 48 hours before Day 1
If a guest cancels **48 hours or more before Day 1 (local Indonesia time)**:
- JVTO issues **JVTO Package Credit equal to 100% of payments received** for the cancelled services.
- No rebooking/administration fee is charged when using valid Package Credit.

### Cancellation < 48 hours before Day 1
If a guest cancels **less than 48 hours before Day 1**:
- Up to **100% of the total package price may be forfeited**.
- **No Package Credit or cash refund** is normally provided.

### No-show & same-day cancellation
Situations such as not appearing at pickup, refusing to depart after crew/vehicles are deployed, or cancelling on the same day are treated as no-show/same-day cancellation:
- Up to **100% of the total package price is forfeited**.
- **No refund or Package Credit** is provided for unused services.

### Skipping activities / leaving early
If a guest chooses to skip activities or end the tour early for personal reasons, the full package price remains payable and no partial refund or discount applies.

---

Your exact inclusions depend on your chosen package and what is written on your voucher, but eligible JVTO private tour packages typically include:

- Professional crew (driver, guide/escort guide, and required licensed local guides)
- Entrance tickets/permits for the attractions listed in your itinerary
- Ijen safety gear (gas mask, trekking poles) and a mandatory pre-hike health screening (when Ijen is included)

JVTO operates a Lifetime Package Credit policy. Cancelling your whole booking 48 hours or more before Day 1 converts 100% to Lifetime Package Credit—non-expiring, not cash, and preserving your original package, pax entitlement, and confirmed price. Package Credit may be transferred once.

Whole-booking cancellations under 48 hours are forfeited. Cash is not issued for a full cancellation; but when one or more travellers cancel while the tour still runs, the cancelled travellers receive a cash refund of their confirmed price—100% at 48 hours or more before Day 1, 50% within 48 hours, and 0% after Day 1 (at least 2 paying travellers must remain).

- Credit validity: Lifetime / Non-expiring; not cash.
- Transferability: Transferable once (a second transfer is not permitted).
- Partial-traveller cancellation: cash refund 100% / 50% / 0% by timing.
- Currency: IDR (Indonesian Rupiah).
